text: The pipeline begins with the Breast Cancer Image Dataset.
A branch from the dataset leads to the Raw Ultrasonography Images.
The raw images then enter a preprocessing stage.
Inside this stage, the images undergo Scaling.
Next, the data proceeds through Normalization.
The preprocessed output is then sent to Simple Linear Iterative Clustering, labeled SLIC.
The flow continues into a Modified U Net module.
This branch culminates in the Trained Segmentation Model.
In the second parallel branch from the dataset, the data is routed to Masked Image and Labels.
From there, it proceeds to Feature Extraction for VGG 16.
The extracted features then connect to Fully Connected Dense Layers.
This path produces the Trained Detection Model.
Finally, both the Trained Segmentation Model and Trained Detection Model merge into the Pipelining Framework.
